BlueTusk PostgreSQL tooling

Usage:
  bluetusk scaffold [options]
  bluetusk --version

Run 'bluetusk scaffold --help' for scaffold options.

result.stdout:
Usage: bluetusk scaffold [options]

Required:
  --connection <value>          PostgreSQL connection string; alternatively set
                                BLUETUSK_CONNECTION_STRING.

Selection:
  --schema <name>               Include a schema; repeatable.
  --table <schema.table>        Include a table; repeatable.
  --include-graphs              Explicit alias; graphs are included by default.
  --include-functions           Explicit alias; routines are included by default.
  --include-views               Explicit alias; views are included by default.

Generation:
  --output <directory>          Output directory (default: Models).
  --project-dir <directory>     Base project directory (default: current directory).
  --context <name>              DbContext name (default: BlueTuskContext).
  --namespace <name>            Entity namespace (default: BlueTusk.Models).
  --context-namespace <name>    DbContext namespace.
  --root-namespace <name>       Project root namespace.
  --data-annotations            Prefer supported data annotations.
  --use-database-names          Preserve database identifiers in generated names.
  --no-pluralize                Disable pluralization.
  --include-connection-string   Generate OnConfiguring with the supplied connection string.
  --force                       Overwrite generated files that already exist.
